presentation: Explicit production render clock advances once per one-second simulation batch, not a live presentation or performance gate. Paired screenshots are same-tick states. Native full-level prefix is not claimed physical. Actual input begins at production Resume, god disabled before physical E release. Sparse playable mist is weak; visible mist patches established at late pullback/title/credits. No taste/stunning verdict.
